descrizioni.chiedi: Ask for help: I will show you the right commands.
descrizioni.admin-bot config: Configuration: channels, history, restore and export
descrizioni.admin-bot config export: Exports this server's configuration to a file.
descrizioni.admin-bot config import: Imports a configuration from a file exported with /admin-bot config export.
descrizioni.admin-bot config nickname-bot: Changes the bot's name in this server.
descrizioni.admin-bot config pulizia: Removes channels and roles that no longer exist from the settings.
descrizioni.admin-bot config rollback: Restores the previous value of a change.
descrizioni.admin-bot lingua show: Shows the language set for this server.
descrizioni.admin-messaggi promemoria: For staff: the reminders set in this server.
descrizioni.admin-musica canale-richieste: Channel where typing a title queues it, with the player.
descrizioni.admin-musica riepilogo: Shows all the server's music settings.
descrizioni.admin-bot premium: Server premium: status, codes and branding
descrizioni.admin-bot premium aspetto: The bot's avatar, banner and description in this server (premium).
descrizioni.admin-bot premium marchio: Use a bot with your own name and avatar (premium).
descrizioni.admin-bot premium sblocca: Unlocks a premium module for 30 days with coins from the server treasury.
descrizioni.admin-bot premium riscatta: Redeems a premium code for this server.
descrizioni.admin-bot premium stato: Shows how premium is unlocked in this server.
descrizioni.admin-bot setup attiva: Turns the bot's modules on or off, by category.
descrizioni.admin-bot setup wizard: Step-by-step setup of the bot's roles and modules, one category at a time.
descrizioni.admin-ticket chiudi-tutti: Closes the open tickets (up to 25 at a time).
descrizioni.admin-ticket chiusura-auto: Closes tickets idle for N minutes (0 = off).
descrizioni.admin-ticket modmail attiva: Turns ModMail (tickets in DM) on or off.
descrizioni.admin-ticket modmail blocca: Blocks or unblocks a user from ModMail.
descrizioni.admin-ticket pannelli modulo-aggiungi: Adds a question to the form (max 5).
descrizioni.admin-ticket pannelli modulo-mostra: Shows the questions of a panel's form.
descrizioni.admin-ticket pannelli modulo-togli: Removes a question from the form.
descrizioni.admin-ticket pannelli pubblica: Publishes the buttons of one or more panels here.
descrizioni.admin-ticket pannelli rimuovi: Deletes a panel and its form.
descrizioni.admin-ticket sollecito: Reminder after N minutes without staff (0 = off).
descrizioni.admin-ticket risposte standard: Standard replies learned by the staff.
descrizioni.admin-ticket voto: Star rating in DM at closing.
descrizioni.admin-ai attiva: Turns the AI on or off in the server (consent required).
descrizioni.admin-ai canale: Turns the AI off or back on in a channel.
descrizioni.admin-ai conoscenza: Knowledge base used by the assistant
descrizioni.admin-ai conoscenza aggiungi: Adds an entry to the knowledge base.
descrizioni.admin-ai conoscenza togli: Removes an entry from the knowledge base.
descrizioni.admin-ai costruisci: The AI suggests roles and channels from a description; you confirm.
descrizioni.admin-ai funzioni: Turns on automatic features: reply to mentions, flags.
descrizioni.admin-ai limiti: Spending cap and quotas: per user, per feature, images.
descrizioni.admin-ai lore: Server tone and setting used in every AI text.
descrizioni.admin-ai moderazione: The AI flags suspicious messages of a channel to the staff.
descrizioni.admin-ai personaggio: Installs, removes or deletes a server AI character.
descrizioni.admin-ai privacy: User messages sent to the AI, memory and answer length.
descrizioni.admin-ai stato: AI status in the server: providers, settings and monthly usage.
descrizioni.admin-ai traduzione: Automatically translates every message of a channel.
descrizioni.admin-ai vietate: Words or topics the AI must refuse.
descrizioni.admin-antinuke canale-allarmi: Choose where Anti-Nuke alarms are sent (channel or forum).
descrizioni.admin-antinuke casi: Log of stopped attacks: list or detail of a case.
descrizioni.admin-antinuke guardie: Guards on single actions: role permissions, roles to members, links, bots.
descrizioni.admin-antinuke limits: Sets the detection threshold for a category.
descrizioni.admin-antinuke punish-action: What to do to the author of a mass destructive action.
descrizioni.admin-antinuke recovery: Turns automatic re-creation of channels/roles deleted during an attack on or off.
descrizioni.admin-antinuke rilascia: Lifts the quarantine of a case's author and gives their roles back.
descrizioni.admin-antinuke trusted-add: Exempts a user, bot or webhook from Anti-Nuke checks.
descrizioni.admin-antinuke trusted-list: Lists who is exempt from Anti-Nuke checks and with which limits.
descrizioni.admin-antinuke trusted-remove: Removes a user, bot or webhook from the Anti-Nuke trusted list.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid account-age: Minimum account age to not be considered suspicious.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid avatar-check: Turns missing-avatar detection on or off.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid elenco: File with every raid account from the last hours.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid filtro-ingresso: Action for a join filter (works outside a raid too).
descrizioni.admin-antiraid join-rate: Sets the join limit in a time window.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid livello: Alert levels: normal, alert, high, lockdown.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid lockdown-action: What to do when a raid is detected.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid nomi-vietati: Words or patterns (with *) banned in the names of new members.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid ping-ruoli: Staff roles pinged on the first raid alert (empty: none).
descrizioni.admin-antiraid quarantine-hold: Stops untrusted people from lifting quarantine by hand.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid rilascia: Lifts a member's quarantine (the right way, with the lock on).
descrizioni.admin-antiraid segnala: Report an undetected raid to the bot team.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid segnali: Raid signals on the latest joins and action on earlier joiners.
descrizioni.admin-antiraid username-check: Turns suspicious username pattern detection on or off.
descrizioni.admin-automod esenzioni: Channels and roles exempt from the filters.
descrizioni.admin-automod esenzioni channel-add: Exempts a channel from all advanced AutoMod filters.
descrizioni.admin-automod esenzioni role-add: Exempts a role from all advanced AutoMod filters.
descrizioni.admin-filtri actions-set: Sets which actions run when an advanced filter triggers.
descrizioni.admin-filtri anti-attachment: Configures anti attachment-spam (too many attachments in a short time).
descrizioni.admin-filtri anti-link-domain: Adds or removes a domain from the link whitelist/blacklist.
descrizioni.admin-filtri anti-mention: Configures anti mass-mention (too many users tagged in one message).
descrizioni.admin-filtri anti-spam-emoji: Configures emoji anti-spam (too many emoji in one message).
descrizioni.admin-filtri anti-spam-messages: Configures message anti-spam (too many messages in a short time).
descrizioni.admin-filtri anti-spam-sticker: Configures sticker anti-spam (too many stickers in a short time).
descrizioni.admin-filtri anti-zalgo: Turns anti-zalgo on or off (text with abnormal diacritics).
descrizioni.admin-filtri canale-media: Media-only channel, no attachments or normal.
descrizioni.admin-filtri contenuto: Embeds and forwards checked by filters; banned file types.
descrizioni.admin-filtri forma-testo: Limits on message shape: line breaks, length, spoilers (0 = off).
descrizioni.admin-filtri invites: Turns the automatic Discord invite block on or off.
descrizioni.admin-filtri messaggi: Repeated, too short, links and mentions counted over time (0 = off).
descrizioni.admin-filtri phishing: Turn the phishing link block on or off (fake gifts, fake logins).
descrizioni.admin-automod violazione-togli: Removes one violation from the AutoMod log.
descrizioni.admin-automod violazioni: Shows a user's AutoMod violations, in pages.
descrizioni.admin-automod log-channel: Sets the channel for the advanced AutoMod action log.
descrizioni.admin-automod mute-duration: Sets the timeout length used by the AutoMod 'mute' action.
descrizioni.admin-automod odio: Banned words with variants and hate slurs.
descrizioni.admin-automod odio base: Turns the base list of hate slurs on or off.
descrizioni.owner parole-odio: Bot owner only: the worldwide library of hate words.
descrizioni.admin-automod odio nomi: Checks nicknames and display names on join and on change.
descrizioni.admin-automod odio parola: Adds or removes a custom word or an allowed word.
descrizioni.admin-automod odio prova: Tests a text against the banned words without acting.
descrizioni.admin-automod odio richiami: How many warnings for hate words lead to a timeout.
descrizioni.admin-automod odio stato: Shows how the banned words are set up.
descrizioni.admin-automod status: Shows the current advanced AutoMod filter setup.
descrizioni.admin-automod sync: Forces a manual sync of the AutoMod rules.
descrizioni.admin-backup annulla: Stops the running load (what is done stays).
descrizioni.admin-backup carica: Loads a saved copy into this server, picking the parts.
descrizioni.admin-backup chat carica: Loads a saved chat into a channel, even a different one.
descrizioni.admin-backup chat salva: Saves the latest messages of a channel (up to 1000) to load them later.
descrizioni.admin-backup collega: Links THIS server as backup, with the code received from the main server.
descrizioni.admin-backup copia canale: Copies a channel with its permissions; a category with its channels.
descrizioni.admin-backup copia ruolo: Copies a role with its permissions and, optionally, its channel permissions.
descrizioni.admin-backup crea: Prepares the backup: link code and link for the new server.
descrizioni.admin-backup esporta: Exports structure, channels, roles, bans or reactions to a file.
descrizioni.admin-backup importa: Imports the structure from a JSON file, picking what to apply.
descrizioni.admin-backup lista: The saved copies of this server, with their date.
descrizioni.admin-backup main: Registers this server as 'main' for the Backup System.
descrizioni.admin-backup modello: Templates: share a copy with a code or load another server one.
descrizioni.founder backup permessi: Who can create and who can load backups (owner only).
descrizioni.admin-backup promuovi: Promotes THIS server (so far a backup) to new main, if the original main is lost.
descrizioni.admin-backup registro: Who used backups, templates and syncs (last 20, 365 days).
descrizioni.admin-backup ripristino modo: Picks how this server handles user restore via OAuth2.
descrizioni.admin-backup ripristino utenti: Restores into THIS server the users of another server's latest snapshot.
descrizioni.admin-backup salva: Saves a dated copy of this server structure.
descrizioni.founder backup sincronia: Keeps bans and roles equal with another server of yours.
descrizioni.admin-backup stato: Progress of the latest load in this server.
descrizioni.clan: Server clans: create, manage and grow your clan
descrizioni.admin-economia annunci clan-off: Turns off the automatic top 3 guilds announcement.
descrizioni.admin-economia annunci clan-set: Sets the channel for the monthly top 3 guilds announcement.
descrizioni.clan boost: XP/coin boosts of the Guild/Clan system.
descrizioni.clan boost gilda: Buys a x2 boost for 24h for ALL members, from the treasury.
descrizioni.clan boost individuale: Buys a personal x2 boost for 24h on your guild voice tick.
descrizioni.clan classifica: Guild leaderboard by XP (monthly or total).
descrizioni.clan compra-canale: Unlocks a new extra channel for your guild.
descrizioni.clan espelli: Expels a member from your guild.
descrizioni.clan invita: Invites a member to your guild.
descrizioni.clan lascia: Leaves the guild you belong to.
descrizioni.clan promuovi: Changes the role of a member of your guild.
descrizioni.clan tesoreria dona: Donates personal coins to your guild's treasury.
descrizioni.clan tesoreria trasferisci: Moves coins from the treasury to another guild of YOURS (even on another server).
descrizioni.admin-economia assegna-lobby: Participation prize: gives coins to those in voice NOW, from the server treasury.
descrizioni.admin-economia assegna-winner: Winner prize: gives coins to a member, from the server treasury.
descrizioni.admin-economia cassa-premium: Unlocks one month of premium bot by spending from the treasury.
descrizioni.admin-giveaway modello: Giveaway templates: save, list, delete, start.
descrizioni.admin-giveaway programmati: Scheduled giveaways: list (including failed ones) or cancel.
descrizioni.admin-livelli progressi: Turns missions, streaks, achievements and pass on or off; sets the server goal.
descrizioni.admin-economia shop-add: Adds an item to the shop.
descrizioni.admin-economia shop-edit: Edits a shop item (price, stock, required role...).
descrizioni.admin-economia shop-remove: Removes an item from the shop.
descrizioni.admin-economia annunci vincitori-off: Turns off the monthly winners announcement.
descrizioni.admin-economia annunci vincitori-set: Sets the channel for the monthly winners announcement.
descrizioni.admin-livelli membro: Edits a member's XP and level.
descrizioni.fun: Fun: dice, questions, jokes, games of chance
descrizioni.fun casuale: Would you rather, topic, advice, magic item.
descrizioni.fun coinflip: Flips a coin: heads or tails.
descrizioni.admin-moduli conteggio: Counting game: pick the channel where people count 1, 2, 3... in turn.
descrizioni.immagini effetto: Avatar effect: rainbow, R.I.P., wanted, triggered.
descrizioni.giochi gioca: Play your coins: coin flip, dice or slots.
descrizioni.immagini meme: Makes a meme with top/bottom text.
descrizioni.fun misura: Measures from 0 to 100% how much of something you choose.
descrizioni.fun numero: A random number in a range.
descrizioni.giochi rps: Rock, paper, scissors against the bot.
descrizioni.fun scegli: I pick at random among the options you write.
descrizioni.fun scherzo: A harmless prank on a user.
descrizioni.immagini search-image: Searches a SFW image on Pixabay.
descrizioni.fun ship: Computes the compatibility between two users.
descrizioni.fun testo: Write a text in a special style.
descrizioni.admin-benvenuto anteprima: Shows a preview of how a message would look.
descrizioni.admin-benvenuto extra: Welcome: DM text, variants, reactions; ban and goodbye messages.
descrizioni.admin-benvenuto immagine: Adds to the welcome an image with the member's avatar, name and number.
descrizioni.admin-ruoli auto aggiungi: Adds a role given automatically to new members.
descrizioni.admin-ruoli auto ricorda: Gives roles back to people who leave and rejoin within a set time.
descrizioni.admin-ruoli auto togli: Removes a role given automatically to new members.
descrizioni.admin-ruoli premio aggiungi: Gives a role to whoever reaches a level.
descrizioni.admin-ruoli premio elenco: Shows the reward roles configured on this server.
descrizioni.admin-ruoli menu accesso: Limits a menu to certain roles or excludes others.
descrizioni.admin-ruoli menu aggiungi: Adds an option to a role menu.
descrizioni.admin-ruoli menu elenco: Shows the server's role menus, with IDs.
descrizioni.admin-ruoli menu modifica: Changes title, description or behavior of an already published menu.
descrizioni.admin-ruoli menu togli: Removes an option from a role menu.
descrizioni.admin-ticket limite: How many open tickets each user can have at once (default 1).
descrizioni.admin-ticket panel: Publishes the ticket opening panel in this channel.
descrizioni.admin-ticket setup: Sets the category (and optionally the support role) for tickets.
descrizioni.admin-vocali cap: Sets the maximum number of temporary voice channels per category.
descrizioni.admin-vocali generatore: Extra generator channels with their own rules.
descrizioni.admin-vocali opzioni: Name of new channels, lock, log, copy, panel.
descrizioni.admin-vocali panel: Publishes the panel to create a voice channel by hand.
descrizioni.admin-vocali piattaforme: Sets the PC/Console/Mobile info roles for temporary voice channels.
descrizioni.admin-vocali setup: Sets the generator channel and category for temporary voice channels.
descrizioni.level: Levels, leaderboards, profile, collection and invites
descrizioni.level calcola: How many messages or voice minutes are missing to reach a level.
descrizioni.level collezione: Collection: badges and backgrounds for your profile, bought with coins.
descrizioni.level collezione compra: Buys a badge or background with your coins.
descrizioni.level collezione equipaggia: Puts a badge or background on your profile (no item removes it).
descrizioni.level collezione negozio: Shows badges and backgrounds on sale and the ones you own.
descrizioni.level compleanno imposta: Saves your birthday (day and month only).
descrizioni.admin-livelli annuncio: Where and when to announce level-ups.
descrizioni.admin-livelli card: Shows or hides image backgrounds of cards and profiles in this server.
descrizioni.admin-livelli escludi: A channel, category or role gives no XP (repeat to undo).
descrizioni.admin-livelli moltiplicatore: XP multiplied in a channel or for a role (factor 1 = removes the rule).
descrizioni.admin-livelli negozio: Asks for confirmation before each shop purchase (can be turned off).
descrizioni.admin-livelli premi: Reward roles: keep them all or only the highest.
descrizioni.admin-livelli xp: How much XP and coins are earned, and how multipliers add up.
descrizioni.level inviti: How many people each person invited
descrizioni.level inviti classifica: The 10 members who invited the most people.
descrizioni.level inviti utente: How many people a member invited.
descrizioni.level inviti storico: Who invited a member and the last people they brought in.
descrizioni.level inviti link: Your personal invite link, served through the bot's website.
descrizioni.admin-moduli inviti: Invite log channel and who has the personal link.
descrizioni.level livelli-recenti: The last 25 level-ups in the server.
descrizioni.monete attese: When you can use daily and work again.
descrizioni.level premi: Shows level reward roles and active XP multipliers.
descrizioni.level progressi: Missions, streaks, achievements and the 90-day pass, in a menu.
descrizioni.level profilo: Shows a member's profile; with "presentazione" you change yours.
descrizioni.level rank: Shows the rank card: level, XP, position and coins.
descrizioni.monete shop list: Shows the items available in the shop.
descrizioni.admin-log canale: Sets the server log channel (or forum).
descrizioni.admin-log crea-canali: Creates a private category with one channel for each log type.
descrizioni.admin-log crea-forum: Creates a private forum for logs: one post for each type.
descrizioni.admin-log esporta: Exports the full server event history as a JSON file.
descrizioni.admin-log archivio-canale: Download the latest messages of a channel in a file, including just-deleted ones.
descrizioni.admin-log eventi: Turn each single log event on or off.
descrizioni.admin-log ignora: What the logs do not record (channels, users, roles; texts only for messages).
descrizioni.admin-log stato: Shows where the server logs go.
descrizioni.admin-log vista-forum: A forum with one post for each channel or case. Without a forum, the view turns off.
descrizioni.mod-casi avvisi azzera: Removes all of a member's active warnings (needs "Manage Server").
descrizioni.mod-casi avvisi classifica: Members with the most active warnings.
descrizioni.mod-casi avvisi togli: Removes a single warning (by case number).
descrizioni.mod-casi rischio: A member's risk score, with the reasons. Only an aid to decide.
descrizioni.mod-casi carico: Staff workload and proposed shifts. Admins only, never public.
descrizioni.mod-canali blocco attiva: Lock all channels, invites and joins of the server.
descrizioni.mod-canali blocco togli: Reopen the server as it was before the lockdown.
descrizioni.mod-casi caso: History and details of moderation cases.
descrizioni.mod-casi caso attive: Sanctions still running: tempbans, timeouts, mutes, timed locks.
descrizioni.mod-casi caso registra: Logs a case without taking the action (sanction given outside the bot).
descrizioni.mod-sanzioni opzioni imposta: Ban message cleanup, timeout, external cases, alerts. Empty: shows the options.
descrizioni.mod-sanzioni opzioni dm: Choose whether the user gets a DM for a type of action.
descrizioni.founder moderazione immuni: Roles manual moderation can't touch (owner only).
descrizioni.mod-casi caso classifica-staff: Moderator leaderboard by number of actions, or one moderator's cases.
descrizioni.mod-casi caso motivo: Changes the reason of an already logged case.
descrizioni.mod-casi caso vedi: Shows the details of a single case.
descrizioni.mod-canali clear: Deletes a number of messages, with optional filters.
descrizioni.mod-canali lock: Blocks the ability to write in a channel.
descrizioni.mod-sanzioni massa: Actions on several members at once.
descrizioni.mod-sanzioni massa timeout: Times out several members at once (max 28 days).
descrizioni.mod-sanzioni mute: Mutes a member with a dedicated role (alternative to timeout).
descrizioni.mod-casi nota aggiungi: Adds a note on a user.
descrizioni.mod-casi nota elenca: Lists the notes on a user.
descrizioni.mod-casi nota rimuovi: Removes a note (the number is in the notes list).
descrizioni.mod-casi nota svuota: Deletes all of a member's notes (needs "Manage Server").
descrizioni.mod-canali unlock: Unblocks the ability to write in a channel.
descrizioni.mod-sanzioni unmute: Removes the mute role from a member.
descrizioni.mod-ban appelli canale: Picks the staff channel for appeals (empty to turn them off).
descrizioni.mod-ban kick: Kicks a member from the server.
descrizioni.mod-ban massa: Actions on several users at once.
descrizioni.mod-ban massa ban: Bans several users at once, even outside the server (IDs or mentions).
descrizioni.mod-ban massa kick: Kicks several members at once (IDs or mentions).
descrizioni.mod-ban softban: Bans and unbans a member right away, to delete their recent messages.
descrizioni.mod-ban tempban: Bans a member for a set time.
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert: Alerts from feeds, Twitch, YouTube and webhooks
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert elenco: Shows the feeds followed by this server.
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert feed: Follows an RSS/Atom feed (YouTube, Reddit, or any other).
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert guida-social: Alerts for TikTok, Instagram and X.
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert kick: Notify when a Kick channel goes live.
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert opzioni: Alert options: role, end of stream, button.
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert rimuovi: Removes a feed or Twitch subscription, or a webhook.
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert ruolo-live: Role given to members who are live.
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert twitch: Notifies when a Twitch streamer goes live/offline.
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert webhook: Creates a custom webhook: third-party services can post in a channel.
descrizioni.admin-moduli alert youtube-live: Notifies when a YouTube channel goes live (needs YOUTUBE_API_KEY on the bot).
descrizioni.admin-moduli candidature elimina: Deletes a form and its answers.
descrizioni.admin-messaggi tag prefisso: Picks the prefix to use commands by typing in the channel.
descrizioni.admin-moduli compleanni canale: Picks the wishes channel (empty to turn them off).
descrizioni.admin-moduli compleanni ruolo: A role for 24 hours for whoever has a birthday (empty to remove it).
descrizioni.admin-moduli contatori crea: Creates a channel that shows a number.
descrizioni.admin-moduli contatori elimina: Stops updating a counter (the channel stays).
descrizioni.admin-messaggi embed crea: Creates an embed and shows the preview.
descrizioni.admin-messaggi embed elimina: Deletes a saved embed (the published message stays).
descrizioni.admin-messaggi embed modifica: Edits a saved embed (and the already published message).
descrizioni.admin-messaggi embed pubblica: Sends a saved embed to a channel.
descrizioni.admin-moduli starboard: Board of the most voted messages
descrizioni.admin-moduli starboard imposta: Picks the board channel and the star threshold.
descrizioni.admin-moduli starboard soglia: Changes how many stars are needed to reach the board.
descrizioni.admin-moduli statistiche: Activity statistics and roles by activity
descrizioni.admin-moduli statistiche diagnosi: Why are the statistics not counting?
descrizioni.admin-moduli statistiche elenco: Show the statistics rules and exclusions.
descrizioni.admin-moduli statistiche impostazioni: Exclude channels or roles from the statistics.
descrizioni.admin-moduli statistiche ruolo-aggiungi: Give a role to active members and remove it when they stop.
descrizioni.music clear-queue: Clears the queue without touching the track that is playing.
descrizioni.music disconnect: Disconnects the music bot from the voice channel.
descrizioni.music history: Shows the latest tracks already played.
descrizioni.music join: Makes the music bot join your channel without playing.
descrizioni.music loop: Repeats the current track or the whole queue.
descrizioni.music loop queue: Turns repeat of the whole queue on or off.
descrizioni.music loop track: Turns repeat of the current track on or off.
descrizioni.music nonstop: Continuous looped playback on the active music session.
descrizioni.music nonstop on: Turns on the continuous loop on the current queue.
descrizioni.music nowplaying: Shows the playing track with a progress bar.
descrizioni.music playlist: Your saved playlists: they work in every server.
descrizioni.music playlist carica: Queues one of your saved playlists.
descrizioni.music playlist elimina: Deletes one of your saved playlists.
descrizioni.music playlist esporta: Downloads one of your playlists as a file.
descrizioni.music playlist importa: Saves a playlist from an exported file.
descrizioni.music playlist salva: Saves your channel's queue as a playlist.
descrizioni.music previous: Goes back to the previous track.
descrizioni.music shuffle: Shuffles the order of the queued tracks.
descrizioni.music skip: Skips the track that is playing.
descrizioni.music skipto: Jumps straight to track number N of the queue.
descrizioni.music stop: Stops playback and clears the queue.
descrizioni.music suono: Plays a sound effect in your voice channel.
descrizioni.music volume: Controls the playback volume (0-200, like Discord).
descrizioni.music volume set: Sets the volume to a specific value (0-200).
descrizioni.owner: Commands reserved for the bot owner
descrizioni.owner blacklist: Global blacklist of users and servers
descrizioni.owner blacklist server-add: Globally blocks a server (the bot leaves if already there).
descrizioni.owner blacklist server-remove: Removes a server from the global blacklist.
descrizioni.owner blacklist utente-add: Globally blocks a user from using the bot.
descrizioni.owner blacklist utente-remove: Removes a user from the global blacklist.
descrizioni.owner cog reload: Reloads an extension, optionally updating it from GitHub or a file.
descrizioni.owner premium grant: Grants premium to a server, or creates a code to redeem.
descrizioni.owner premium list: Shows the premium status of all modules.
descrizioni.owner premium panel: Interactive panel to turn premium modules on or off.
descrizioni.owner premium revoke: Revokes a module's subscription for a server.
descrizioni.owner premium status-all: Shows the premium status of ALL servers the bot is in.
descrizioni.owner premium subscriptions: Shows the active per-module subscriptions on a server.
